definition.en: An individual coral animal with a mouth and tentacles.
definition.zh: 有口和触手的单个珊瑚动物。

definition.en: Connected polyps living over a shared skeleton; not the whole reef community.
definition.zh: 连接在共有骨骼上的多个珊瑚虫；不等于整片礁的群落。

definition.en: The hard calcium-carbonate support made by a hard coral.
definition.zh: 硬珊瑚制造的坚硬碳酸钙支撑。

definition.en: A close relationship between different organisms. In this coral example both partners benefit.
definition.zh: 不同生物之间紧密的共同生活关系；本题珊瑚与藻伙伴双方获益。

definition.en: Photosynthetic algae living within coral tissue.
definition.zh: 住在珊瑚组织内、能进行光合作用的藻类。

definition.en: The shallow reef zone nearest the shore; some parts may be exposed at low tide.
definition.zh: 靠岸的浅平礁区，部分地方可在低潮露出水面。

definition.en: The reef’s seaward ridge, exposed to incoming waves.
definition.zh: 迎向传来海浪的礁区外缘。

definition.en: The reef zone descending seaward from the crest.
definition.zh: 由礁脊向海中下降的礁区。

definition.en: The environment in which an organism lives.
Populations of different organisms living together in a place.
definition.zh: 在同一地方共同生活的不同生物种群。

definition.en: An organism making organic food; these examples use light.
definition.zh: 能制造有机食物的生物；本题例子利用光。

definition.en: An organism obtaining food from other organisms.
definition.zh: 从其他生物取得食物的生物。
在水中漂浮、能光合作用的生物。

definition.en: Animal plankton drifting in water; this model selects a phytoplankton-feeding group.
definition.zh: 漂浮在水中的动物类浮游生物；本图选取吃浮游植物的一组。

definition.en: Connected food pathways; this teaching graph selects only some relationships.
definition.zh: 相互连接的食物路径；本教学图只选部分关系。

definition.en: A structure or behaviour helping an organism survive in its environment.
definition.zh: 有助生物在环境中生存的结构或行为。

definition.en: Loss of algal partners and/or their pigments; living tissue can remain.
definition.zh: 失去共生藻或其色素；仍可能保留活组织。

definition.en: Work assisting damaged habitat to recover, with outcomes needing monitoring.
definition.zh: 协助受损生境恢复的工作，结果仍需监测。
